For example, an operation to insert a JPEG file should specify something like `"title": "cat.jpg"` in the metadata. When a Google Drive user requests to download a file, or when the file is downloaded through the sync client, Drive builds a full filename (with extension) based on the title. In cases where the extension is missing, Drive attempts to determine the extension based on the file's MIME type.
